title: Physics-Causality-Anchored Verification Theory (PCAVT) · 唯物实践论
description:
Physics-Causality-Anchored Verification Theory (PCAVT) — formerly 唯物实践论 (Material-Praxis Theory) — is a formally constrained category-derivation system that takes carrying natural language (Chinese) as its symbol basis. It treats the Chinese sign system as a set of B1 constants and derives strictly, giving it a mathematical character: non-ambiguous, derivable, and self-consistent.

Core outputs include the Three Laws (structural conditions for any shared symbolic system), the A-B-C six-subset framework (A material substrate, B information, C agent), and difference analysis (A2 − A1, the material net output of human practice). The repository publishes the methodology (5th edition), the self-reference-consistency statement, the formalization-alienation critique, and applied papers (economics, gender narrative, education, AI/LLM training-data quality), together with reproducible scripts and figures.

This record archives the public repository as a citable research corpus.
